report.executiveSummary: During the incident window, Contoso Retail customers experienced degraded checkout and product catalogue performance (p99: 2800ms). Investigation evidence indicates the root cause is service-side, specifically: Client-side p99 latency: 2800ms vs server-side Cosmos latency: 650ms — 2150ms gap indicates client/SDK or host overhead; Cosmos DB 429 RateLimitExceeded: 50 in last 5 min on products container. Azure Cosmos DB service-side health remained degraded (server-side latency: 650ms). Azure SQL Database remained healthy. Immediate corrective actions are identified and safe to execute without service escalation.
report.engineeringRca: Telemetry shows p99 latency at 2800ms with 50 Cosmos 429 events, 450 RU/min consumption, host CPU 22%, and SQL latency 80ms. The active toggles (none) directly align with the observed failure signature. The client-to-server latency delta of 2150ms indicates most latency is introduced in the application, SDK, query design, or host execution path rather than inside the Azure Cosmos DB service plane.
